svg.title: Vector width and entry count are different axes
svg.desc: Both panels start with an8-row,4-column grid. A keeps positions p0–p7 in an8×2 grid, highlighting components4→2 in orange. B produces a4×4 grid with rows b0={p0,p1},b1={p2,p3},b2={p4,p5},b3={p6,p7}, highlighting rows8→4.
